# Research

- 2026-11-07 [GPUI: Rust and Zed's GPU UI as a replacement for Electron and Solid (#152)](2026-11-07-gpui.md): GPUI desk study: no-go for a migration today, go for a measured prototype; others measured 20 to 25 MB idle
- 2026-11-07 [GPUI prototype: Grace's main screen in Rust and GPUI, measured against Grace on Linux (#152)](2026-11-07-gpui-prototype/README.md): GPUI prototype on Windows: go for a migration with the idle patch; 28 MB idle against 167 MB, 192 MB unpacked against 489 MB, faster first paint
- 2026-11-02 [Step debugger spike: a Karate `RunListener` that pauses steps](2026-11-02-step-debugger/README.md): Step debugger spike: Karate 2.1.4's RunListener can pause every step and read variables; ECJ compiles the listener in 0.9 s on the bundled JRE
- 2026-11-02 [Project libraries: sample projects and their check](2026-11-02-project-libraries/README.md): Sample Maven and Gradle projects and a by-hand Playwright check that Grace lists and runs a project's libraries; results are in docs/checks
- 2026-11-02 [Java's JIT during a Karate run: C1 only, fewer compiler threads](2026-11-02-java-jit/README.md): Java JIT: C1 only cuts CPU 53 to 75% but heavy JavaScript runs 4 times slower; two compiler threads cut CPU 10 to 52% with no JavaScript loss
- 2026-11-01 [Java's memory during a Karate run: heap flags, collector, class-data sharing](2026-11-01-java-memory/README.md): Java memory: -Xms64m -Xmx2g cuts the 10,000-test peak from 455 to 318 MB for 5% more CPU; serial GC does not help, class-data sharing costs 19 MB
- 2026-10-31 [Idle CPU while shown: the console cursor's blink](2026-10-31-idle-cpu-shown.md): Idle CPU while shown: the console cursor blinked forever; blinking only during work cut idle CPU from 1.3-2.1 s to 0.23 s a minute
- 2026-10-29 [Tauri spike: Tauri 2 as a replacement for Electron (#106)](2026-10-29-tauri-spike/README.md): Tauri 2 spike: no-go, stay on Electron; zip shrinks 71% but memory and start time do not improve and it needs a Rust rewrite
- 2026-10-29 [Moving the backlog to Linear](2026-10-29-linear-backlog.md): Linear backlog move: no-go, stay on GitHub Issues; it saves one manual step but makes the backlog private and the free plan caps at 250 issues
- 2026-10-29 [Big-project performance: 2,000 and 10,000 tests in the premium UI](2026-10-29-big-project-perf/README.md): Big-project perf: tooltips are not the cause; batching run events (18.6 s to 7 s), scroll fixes and a virtualized tree fix 2,000 and 10,000 tests
- 2026-10-28 [Linux Actions minutes in October 2026](2026-10-28-linux-actions-minutes.md): October Linux Actions minutes: grace used 171 of 775, the rest came from another repo; merge-when-green waste is not fixable, Windows drives the quota
- 2026-10-27 [CI test speed: why the `test` workflow takes 20 minutes, and how to cut it](2026-10-27-ci-test-speed.md): CI test speed: one Java test file takes 422 s; split unit and e2e into jobs and cut a ready PR from 20 to 7 minutes for 3 more billed minutes
- 2026-10-24 [Vitest spike: unit tests for main-process logic and Solid 2 components](2026-10-24-vitest-spike/README.md): Vitest spike: Node and jsdom tests of Solid 2 pass in about 1.5 s with two projects split by file name and Solid's browser build inlined
- 2026-10-24 [Stack research: Electron + Solid 2 + TanStack + Tailwind (karate-kid)](2026-10-24-stack.md): Stack study: keep Electron, Solid 2 RC pinned, TanStack Router (not Start) and Tailwind v4; Start adds weight in Electron
- 2026-10-24 [Stack spike: Electron Forge 8 + Solid 2 RC + TanStack Router + Tailwind v4](2026-10-24-stack-spike/README.md): Stack spike: Electron Forge 8, Solid 2 RC, TanStack Router and Tailwind v4 build, run and package; 21 s package, 152 KB app.asar
- 2026-10-24 [Playwright spike: end-to-end tests for the Electron app](2026-10-24-playwright-spike/README.md): Playwright works for Electron e2e tests; the packaged exe fails to launch with the Forge fuse off, so test the built app with the dev Electron binary
